html: The Nimanburu were an Aboriginal Australian people of the west Kimberley in Western Australia, near the base of the Dampier Peninsula by King Sound. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Ngumbarl, Jabirr Jabirr and Nyulnyul to the west and north and the Nyikina to the east. Their language belonged to the Nyulnyulan family.
